title: Accessibility standard?
question: Last product-truth question. click-web already searches generated card colors to WCAG 4.5:1 contrast. Is there a broader accessibility or inclusion requirement future work must honor? Brand, legal, or naming constraints can go in the note — otherwise those stay as shipped: Click, Click for Business, joinclick.co, “Stop scrolling. Start living.”

options.label: WCAG 2.2 AA
options.thesis: Ship to WCAG 2.2 AA on web surfaces: contrast, names, keyboard, focus, and targets.
options.body: Generated card visuals already target 4.5:1. Elevate that to the whole product, including landing, dashboard, events, and insights.

options.label: Keep today’s bar
options.thesis: No extra product-wide standard beyond what already exists in code.
options.body: Preserve 4.5:1 on generated CardVisual surfaces. Do not invent a broader AA/AAA commitment in PRODUCT.md. Record accessibility as an open decision.

options.label: Named user needs
options.thesis: There are specific inclusion needs (motor, vision, language, vestibular, etc.) that AA alone would miss.
options.body: Use the note to name them. They will be written into Accessibility & Inclusion as confirmed requirements.

options.label: Leave it undecided
options.thesis: Do not lock a standard this round.
options.body: PRODUCT.md will mark accessibility as an open decision rather than implying a commitment.
